nodes.label: vmagent
nodes.desc: Standalone agent that scrapes metrics and remote-writes them to VictoriaMetrics (main at L105).

nodes.label: victoria-metrics-prod
nodes.desc: Single-node binary wiring vmstorage.Init, vmselect.Init and vminsert.Init into one process (L99-L103); serves HTTP on :8428 (L93).

nodes.label: vminsert
nodes.desc: Multi-protocol ingestion package: Init (L91) and RequestHandler (L134) route /prometheus/api/v1/write and friends (L171).

nodes.label: InsertCtx
nodes.desc: Per-request context buffering rows: WriteDataPoint (L133) and FlushBufs (L275) push MetricRows downstream (L292).

nodes.label: vmselect
nodes.desc: Query-side HTTP routing: Init (L49), /api/v1/query (L207) and /api/v1/query_range (L216), plus the /vmui web UI (L454).

nodes.label: promql eval
nodes.desc: MetricsQL/PromQL evaluation: EvalConfig (L116) and evalExpr (L257); fetches raw series via netstorage.ProcessSearchQuery (L1834).

nodes.label: netstorage
nodes.desc: Fetch layer converting SearchQuery into Results: ProcessSearchQuery (L1090), Result (L45).

nodes.label: vmstorage
nodes.desc: Storage app wrapper: Init (L123) opens lib/storage at -storageDataPath (L29, L167) and exposes VMInsertAPI (L200); WriteRows facade in app/vmstorage/vmstorage.go L130.

nodes.label: Storage
nodes.desc: Top-level TSDB object: MustOpenStorage (L183), AddRows (L1659), SearchTSIDs (L1270).

nodes.label: table
nodes.desc: Holds monthly partitions: mustOpenTable (L91), MustAddRows (L300) fans raw rows out to the right partition.

nodes.label: partition
nodes.desc: Per-month data partition with its own indexDB: newPartition (L296), background mergeParts (L1234), mustOpenParts (L1767).

nodes.label: indexDB
nodes.desc: Inverted index mapping label filters to TSIDs: indexDB struct (L77), mustOpenIndexDB (L168), SearchTSIDs (L1934).
